revised_claim_text: Parsyl raised USD 25M in a Series B round in January 2022 (corrected from '2024' in source draft), led by HSCM Ventures. The IoT Data Partner Program, launched March 2024, includes Sensitech (formerly Berlinger), Copeland (formerly Emerson), Roambee, and Tive — Controlant is not a confirmed partner. ColdCover parametric settlement window is documented at 72 hours under the parametric product terms (vendor cites 48 hours and 'same-day' for individual claims). The $4 trillion perishable food + pharma addressable market figure is from Parsyl's own press releases — [ASSUMED-N], not independently corroborated.
footnote_for_artifact: Parsyl $25M Series B funding date corrected to January 2022 per three independent trade publications: Reinsurance News, Artemis.bm, and Insurtech Insights (all Jan 27-31, 2022). Data Partner Program partner list per Parsyl's March 2024 launch announcement, cross-verified by Berlinger's independent announcement. Insurance Insider coverage [NEEDS-ATTENDED-FETCH]: portal.insuranceinsider.com/article/29mxhpl4qywkjwby119mo. ColdCover 48-hour vs 72-hour and the $4T TAM are vendor-only.
